Draft 1 - sampled
To both parties: this dispute is ESCALATED to a human reviewer under POL-RD-10(5). Escalation is terminal and replaces the ruling, so no refund and no payment issue today: the SGD 30.69 charge on EV-FARE-02855 is held (not collected, not refunded), and the SGD 8.50 in dispute is held with it. Why escalation. The driver's statement explains the route by saying 'PIE was closed' and expressly cites LTA advisory EV-ADVIS-02855-01. That artifact is in the bundle but is MISSING: status MISSING, payload null, weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT (POL-GEN-02(3) — a missing artifact can carry no fact and its absence is itself citable). POL-RD-13 tests an external-traffic assertion against the trip's traffic advisory, and it states that where the asserting party does cite the missing identifier, POL-RD-10(5) is not narrowed. The driver positively cited EV-ADVIS-02855-01, so POL-RD-03 (a driver-favouring exculpatory clause) is invoked against a cited artifact that is missing from the pool: that is the POL-RD-10(5) trigger. The driver's point that escalation preserves the present payment state (refund_issued_sgd 0.00) is correct. What the record shows. The trace EV-GPS-02855 is NOT impaired for policy purposes: 184 fixes, 10 s interval, 100% coverage, no gaps, max_gap_sec 0.0, so limbs (a)–(c) of POL-RD-07 all fail and POL-RD-10(3) is not in play — the escalation rests on (5) alone. On that trace the trip measured 23.41 km against the booked optimal of 17.6 km (EV-TRIP-02855): excess 5.81 km / 33.0%, above both POL-RD-01 establishment gates (>0.8 km and >20%) but below both materiality gates (8.0 km, 50%), so no POL-RD-06 uplift and no conduct referral arises (driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d 0 over 278 completed trips). EV-CHAT-02855 holds 0 messages, so there is no POL-RD-04 rider-requested-detour exoneration, and the billed 23.4 km is only 0.01 km short of the trace, so no POL-RD-04 driver compensation. The rider's evidence-based points are accepted: the deviation is established on a clean trace, no advisory on file supports the driver, and the rider's counters (deviation_claims_60d 0, deviation_claims_60d_substantiated 0) impose no heightened burden. They do not move the outcome, because escalation replaces the money ruling. What would have been paid, for transparency. The fare is METERED (EV-FARE-02855), so had the case been decidable the POL-RD-02 arithmetic would be ((3.80 + 0.75 x 17.6 + 0.28 x 23.8) x 1.0 surge, read from the FARE_BREAKDOWN and nowhere else) + 0.80 platform fee = 24.4640, against charged_total 30.69, i.e. 6.2260, rounded up to 6.25 — a PARTIAL_REFUND of 6.25, above the 0.50 de minimis and 20.29% of charged (well below the 90% full-refund share), not the 8.50 claimed. That arithmetic is not reached today. What evidence would resolve it.
